statement: SK Group and NVIDIA announced a '$500-billion-plus' partnership on July 24, 2026, formalized through letters of intent covering AI factory construction and next-generation memory supply.
why: A commitment of this size from a single industrial group is one of the largest customer commitments on record for NVIDIA's platform and signals multi-year forward demand rather than a spot order.

impact.mechanism: A headline partnership spanning AI factories and memory supply locks a very large buyer to NVIDIA's platform while committing memory capacity to it, pulling through GPUs, HBM, data-center build and power.

evidence.excerpt: SK Group and NVIDIA announced plans for a '$500-billion-plus' comprehensive partnership to build AI infrastructure, formalized via letters of intent spanning AI factory construction and next-generation memory supply.

confidence.basis: Primary vendor newsroom announcement (filing-grade primary tier), with the figure and structure quoted directly; note the commitment is at letter-of-intent stage, not a binding purchase order.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 2.0 -> 500.0 (tol 1%); sources: NVIDIA Newsroom
